name: Speechmatics
summary: Provides advanced speech recognition technology, supporting various languages and dialects for accurate transcriptions.
description: Provides advanced speech recognition technology, supporting various languages and dialects for accurate transcriptions. Speechmatics builds speech-to-text APIs for real conversations, not clean demos. Build Voice AI that understands accents, multiple speakers, and multilingual speech. Transcription support: Provides tools for converting speech to text. Noise reduction: Reduces unwanted sounds from audio input. Voice synthesis: Can generate or clone voices using AI models.
